selection.title: One-step skeletal editing of oxetanes to thietanes using thiourea
selection.authors: Like Luo, Deguang Liu, Dayu Tian et al.
selection.researchCore: Direct O-to-S editing without predibromination: In(OTf)3-assisted thiourea ring-opening, O-cyclization, C–S rearrangement, intramolecular 4-exo-tet closure; stepwise cascade in one operational step
centralControls: Without In(OTf)3 no reaction (Fig6a; SI FigS6)
Independent bromohydrin 63 at 150C gives 55% without In, 64% with In (Fig6b; SI S7)
99% ee S64 to 96% ee R65 (Fig6c; SI S8-12)
Regio-probe 66 gives only 67 at 34%, NOT target 69 (Fig6d; SI S13)
Oxetane 18O 76% -> cyclic urea 18O 74% in CH3CN isotope experiment (Fig6e; SI S14-22)
DFT In-assisted ring opening 27 vs uncatalyzed 46.7 kcal/mol; distortion interaction -42.4 vs -14.1 (Fig7/8; SI S24-25)
scopeLimitations: 2,2-disubstituted oxetanes fail and may isomerize (SI FigS26)
Pendant alkyl halides compete with thiourea SN2
100 C, 24h, 2 equiv ethylene thiourea are material conditions
Bioactivity/potency and price comparisons partly originate in earlier cited data/Apr2026 price snapshots

selection.title: Oxetane-to-azetidine skeletal editing
selection.authors: Dayu Tian, Like Luo, Xian Xiao et al.
selection.researchCore: Orthogonal nonredox two-stage one-pot O-to-N editing: Lewis acid aminolysis to isolated 1,3-aminoalcohol, BEHT triflate-mediated intramolecular dehydrative closure
centralControls: B(C6F5)3 gives 90% NMR yield of ring-opened 1,3-aminoalcohol; no Lewis acid no productive ring opening (Fig2; SI TableS1)
Traditional PPh3/DIAD, acid, MsCl/TsCl activation fail; BEHT 85% NMR ring closure (Fig2; SI TableS2)
Ring-opened intermediate 3 isolated at 80% and final 4 isolated at 80% (SI characterization)
Aromatic primary amines 1.1 equiv B(C6F5)3 10 mol% 60 C; aliphatic primary amines 1.5 equiv Yb(OTf)3 20 mol% 120 C (main Methods/SI)
3,3-disubstituted S1 Koh photocatalytic comparison 32% versus current 75%; Koh photocatalytic complex substrates 69/71/73 fail under authors tested conditions (SI FigS2/3)
scopeLimitations: Certain oxetanes and amine nucleophiles completely fail (SI Tables S4/S5)
Some conditions require LiBF4 2 eq or Yb(OTf)3 50 mol%, hotter solvents and BEHT 2.4 eq
No isotope-labeling/DFT proof for exact oxyphosphonium transition state; mechanistic inference from isolated intermediate and optimization
Pharmacology examples in main Fig1c are referenced precedents, not generalized newly measured SAR
